blog:plas:sitio-2026.content:
# A new version of the PLaS group website

![The redesigned PLaS website](/images/PLaS/blog/sitio-2026.webp)

The **Programming Languages and Systems (PLaS)** research group at Universidad Nacional de Colombia has launched a redesign of its website. The goal is to make it easier to explore the group's research lines, projects, publications and learning resources, with a structure that reads better on both desktop and mobile.

## What's new

- **Home page and navigation** reorganized around the group's sections (About, Research, Projects, Blog, Catalog, Resources, People and Contact).
- **Research lines** with updated descriptions and interactive topic maps.
- **Projects** with detail pages written in markdown (title, image and editorial text).
- **Publications catalog** with filters by type, research line, year and text search.
- **Blog / news** ready for posts with rich content, not just event records.
- **People** split into current members and past students (master's and PhD).

## Technical approach

The new version is built as a modern static site, with an emphasis on performance, readable typography and a visual language aligned with the group's identity and with UNAL's institutional design. Detailed editorial content (projects and blog) is managed in markdown attached to each data entry, so updating text and images does not require changes to the templates.

## Next steps

We will keep adding blog posts, completing project pages and keeping the catalog up to date with the group's publications. If you find a broken link or have suggestions about the published information, write to us through the [contact page](/contact).

### Useful links

- [Explore projects](/projects)
- [See the research lines](/lines)
- [Browse the catalog](/catalog)

blog:plas:seminario-educacion-ingenieria.content:
# Engineering Education Seminar: open doors every Wednesday ![Building 401, the Faculty of Engineering's Insignia Building](/images/PLaS/blog/seminario-educacion-2026.webp) *Building 401 (Insignia Building). Photo: [Agencia de Noticias UNAL](https://agenciadenoticias.unal.edu.co/).* Starting **Wednesday, October 7, 2026**, the **PLaS** group is opening a weekly seminar on engineering education. It is a space to talk, propose and follow up on projects, and to learn together from current research in the field. ## When and where - **When:** every Wednesday, from 4:00 to 6:00 p.m., starting October 7. - **Where:** Building 401 (Insignia Building), room 203, Universidad Nacional de Colombia, Bogotá campus. - **Admission:** free. No registration or RSVP needed. ## What we'll do - **Student project proposals and follow-up:** bring your idea or your progress and get feedback from the group. - **Literature review talks:** presentations on what is being published in engineering education. - **Open discussion** on topics from the research line, such as the use of artificial intelligence in teaching, learning and assessment. ## Who can come? Anyone interested: undergraduate, master's and PhD students, faculty and alumni, from any program. You can attend every session or only the ones that interest you. ## Tell us what you expect To better prepare the sessions, we'd like to know what interests you. **This is not a registration form** and we don't ask for personal data: just your program and your expectations. The form is in Spanish.

Fill in the interest form

If you would like to present a project or a literature review, email us at [plas_fibog@unal.edu.co](mailto:plas_fibog@unal.edu.co) to schedule a date. ### Useful links - [AI-enhanced engineering education research line](/lines/educacion) - [Group members](/people)
